theorem scalarRestriction_openSupported
    (C D : ℕ → CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (τ : ∀ n, C (n + 1) ⟶ C n) (σ : ∀ n, D (n + 1) ⟶ D n)
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (a : SemilinearProperOpen.ringSystem C τ X ⟶ SemilinearProperOpen.ringSystem D σ X)
    (M : SemilinearProperOpen.Derived D σ U) :

      ((SemilinearSections.res a).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((SemilinearProperOpen.J D σ j).obj M))

title: Scalar restriction preserves derived open support
statement: Let C and D be arbitrary towers of commutative rings, let j : U → X be an open immersion of schemes, and let a : C_X → D_X be any map of their sequence ring sheaves. For every object M of the ordinary unbounded derived category of D-systems on U, scalar restriction of J_D(j)(M) belongs to the essential image of J_C(j). The systems and exact ordinary/derived extension functors are [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting], and scalar restriction is [def-coef-semilinear-system-models].

source.place: Tags 03EK and 0D6E; already proved generic subargument of blueprint sk-thm-purity-transport Step 10, moved from the assigned module for compile performance.

proof.text: The ordinary open unit is invertible by the canonical VaryingRing open adjunction. The ordinary support theorem makes its counit invertible on the scalar-restricted open extension. On complexes, exact functors preserve the termwise counit isomorphisms, and the exact derived comparison transfers this to all derived objects by the Q representative comparison. The derived open unit is invertible as well, so the derived counit criterion recognizes the claimed essential-image membership.
